bok.text: Eiganjo is the castle city where O-Kagachi attacks, and refugees fleeing him run into the akki army.
O-Kagachi descends on Eiganjo Castle, rips Yosei in half and ruins the castle, while Toshiro Umezawa teleports into Konda's sanctum and steals the Taken One in the chaos.
Takeno dies protecting Konda, and when O-Kagachi senses the Taken One's absence he retreats, leaving Konda's kingdom in ruins.

dbl.text: In the palace at Eiganjo, Kaito sneaks into the kitchen for blue mochi and is later assigned the emperor herself as his sparring partner, though he does not know it at first.

When an alarm sounds, Kaito finds Kyodai in distress and the emperor missing, and the Imperials blame the Uprisers while Light-Paws refuses to listen to his account, so he resolves to leave the palace and search Kamigawa for the man with the metal arm.
Kaito, Tamiyo and the emperor return to the emperor's garden in Eiganjo, where she agrees to remain while the court prepares against the Uprisers, and then the Uprisers breach Eiganjo's gates.
The Wanderer fights Risona in Kyodai's temple and Kaito knocks her unconscious, ending the battle, and the emperor names Light-Paws her proxy before vanishing from Kamigawa again.

neo.text: Eiganjo Castle is built by Takeshi Konda as a young man, who drove out bandits and united local warlords, before he performs a sacrilegious ritual that imprisons a major spirit and gains him immortality.

That crime starts the Kami War, and in its final months the Myojin gathers worshipers for a large attack on the castle, as O-Kagachi comes to recover his stolen offspring and reduces Eiganjo to rubble.
Toshiro Umezawa steals That Which Was Taken and carries it to safety, and the city is rebuilt on the bones of its former castle.
Later an emperor dies young without an heir, causing a succession crisis and war in Eiganjo, until Kyodai strips the Konda family of rulership and decides that emperors will be chosen by kami.
